known_issues: Admin cannot currently view all users and their reports (regression/unfinished access control or UI listing).

existing_features.title: Update the Admin Users UI to let admins view each user’s reports (per-user drilldown) using existing report data (reports include createdBy principal).
Ensure the admin reports view supports showing all reports (unfiltered) and filtered-by-user reports with clear, English UI labels indicating the current filter.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin should be able to view all users and their reports
Fix backend admin authorization so an allowlisted admin account can successfully access admin-only operations (including listing all users and accessing all reports) after signup/login.

projectName: Fix admin visibility: list all users and view their reports
